sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2023 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing, finished in Radiant Red Tintcoat with a Sky Cool Gray and Jet Black interior. This CT5-V features the desirable 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 11,000 miles. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this CT5-V is a Blackwing model, and notable factory equipment includes 19-inch forged wheels in Tech Bronze, Magnetic Ride Control suspension, an electronic limited-slip differential, an UltraView sunroof, power-adjustable, heated, and ventilated front seats, a suede heated steering wheel, and Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. Cadillac released the CT5-V Blackwing for 2022 to fill the gap left by the CTS-V. The sedan is built on an evolution of its predecessor's rear-wheel drive architecture, and it's powered by a supercharged V8 shared with Chevrolet's last-generation Corvette Z06, among other models. The 28-horsepower bump over the CTS-V makes the CT5-V the fastest and most powerful production car Cadillac has ever released. Power comes from an LT4 supercharged 6.2-liter V8, rated at 668 horsepower and 659 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.
